purpose: Decorative scientific artwork for the standalone Updating Beliefs welcome screen. A metaphor for Bayesian learning, not measured data or an original Think Bayes figure.
processing: Format encoding only; image composition and pixel dimensions preserved. Theme and animation effects are applied by the webpage.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium website welcome-screen hero artwork for a Bayesian statistics learning site called Updating Beliefs. Generate ONLY artwork, no website mockup, no text or lettering.
Primary request: a breathtaking, refined scientific art sculpture that metaphorically depicts uncertain observations converging into a coherent posterior belief. A large ethereal three-dimensional probability wave, shaped as an elegant folded bell-shaped mesh / luminous toroidal ribbon, made of thousands of exquisitely fine pearlescent filaments and tiny discrete silver observation particles. A warm vermilion/coral-red ribbon traces one graceful concentrated crest through the silver field. It should feel like a museum-quality computational sculpture, editorial scientific photography meets sophisticated generative art, physically lit with translucent glass fiber and fine metallic silk. Nuanced depth and finely controlled highlights, believable studio rendering, restrained, mathematical, not a fantasy scene.
Composition: cinematic wide landscape, 16:9. Main sculptural form occupies the center-right two thirds and remains fully contained with breathing room; lower-left and upper-left have generous dark negative space for HTML headings. Background a clean nearly black charcoal (#08090c), seamless with subtle shadow, no visible floor horizon. Close view, beautiful delicate details, high visual clarity, elegant overall silhouette.
Palette: near-black charcoal, pearl silver, pale warm white, restrained crimson and coral red highlights matching a scientific publishing brand. Avoid purple or cyan neon.
Constraints: no labels, no equations, no charts with axes, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no people, no planets, no random decorative shapes. This is abstract decorative artwork, not a plot of measured data. The exact statistical chart and all text will be rendered separately in the website.
